title: finding(gate): check-links.yml's header carries two hand-copied document counts that have drifted
body:
Found while fixing objectui#7448 (the two doc-gate workflow headers whose hand-copied document counts had drifted). The scan that located that card's two instances turned up a third in the same class, in a file outside #7448's declared surface, so it is recorded here rather than fixed there.

## What

`.github/workflows/check-links.yml`'s header states two document counts as literals. Both have drifted, measured today on `main` at `900f8d995`:

| header line | header says | measured today |
|:--|--:|--:|
| "the repo-root `docs/**`, which holds **15** INTERNAL documents (ADRs, audits)" | 15 | 17 |
| "the **183** files the published site is built from live in `content/docs/**`" | 183 | 184 |

Measured with the same walk the workflow's own `args` block declares:

```
find docs -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.mdx' \) | wc -l          # 17
find content/docs -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.mdx' \) | wc -l   # 184
```

## Why it is worth recording

Identical to objectui#7448's diagnosis: nothing fails on a stale number written in a comment, which is exactly why it rots. The counts read as specifications of the scan scope, and this header is specifically the place a contributor goes to learn what the link checker looks at — the paragraph exists to explain that the scope was once pointed at the wrong tree.

The remedy already exists in this repository and was applied twice more on objectui#7448: state the POPULATION, and point at the reading, rather than copying a count. `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`'s `UNGATED_DOCS` header records the original ("a pointer to the list now rather than a copy of its length").

## Not a defect in the gate

`check-links.yml` computes its scope from the `args` glob list, not from this comment. No verdict depends on either number. This is prose accuracy only, which is why it is filed `finding` rather than queued.

## Proposed shape if picked up

objectui#7448 landed a pin in each gate's own test file that fails when a numeral directly qualifies a document-population noun anywhere in that workflow's header comments. `scripts/__tests__/check-links-workflow.test.ts` already exists and already pins this workflow's scope to the directory the site config declares, so it is the natural home for the third copy of that pin. The header edit itself is two sentences.

⚠️ One judgement call for whoever picks it up: this paragraph is partly HISTORICAL — it narrates a scope that "was wrong until #3449". A dated record of a past measurement is not the same defect as a present-tense claim, but both sentences here read present-tense ("holds 15", "the 183 files ... live in"), so both are live claims today.

Back-link: objectui#7448.
